title: Earth-to-Mars effective-distance research program
research_question: Can we shorten the distance to Mars—without changing the traveler?

public_summary.safety: Keep local matter intact and forces survivable.
public_summary.physics: Satisfy the equations, source requirements, energy limits, stability, and cause and effect.
public_summary.proof: Let independent teams recover the same result.
public_summary.current_position: Only the starter measuring test works today.

mechanism_scope.plain_language: The search may change the proposed geometry, fields, matter source, boundary conditions, or path. It may not pretend the route became shorter by redefining or transforming the traveler.

traveler_constraint.plain_language: A useful result must not depend on turning the traveler into a different material state. It must bound the local conditions experienced by the vehicle and people inside.
traveler_constraint.does_not_mean: This does not require every molecule to remain frozen in time. It means the proposed shortcut cannot rely on destructive transformation, unbounded forces, or an undefined traveler model.

dimensions.label: No required transformation
dimensions.description: The mechanism must not create the apparent shortcut by changing the traveler into a different material state.

dimensions.label: Tidal forces
dimensions.description: Relative acceleration across the vehicle and body must stay within a declared survivable bound.

dimensions.label: Felt acceleration
dimensions.description: Acceleration experienced along the path must stay within a declared survivable bound.

dimensions.label: Radiation and field exposure
dimensions.description: Required fields and radiation exposure must be calculated and compared with declared limits.

dimensions.label: Cause and effect
dimensions.description: The route must be checked for horizons, closed causal curves, chronology problems, and loss of controllability.

success_gates.question: Can the system recover a known flat-spacetime answer?
success_gates.downgrade_condition: Downgrade if the frozen candidate, validator, or separate implementation no longer reproduces the published result.

success_gates.question: Can the system evaluate a nontrivial spacetime candidate with a declared source?
success_gates.downgrade_condition: Remain not implemented until a reviewed general or profile-specific solver emits a versioned result.

success_gates.question: Does the candidate reduce a declared effective path length or travel time?
success_gates.downgrade_condition: Remain not evaluated until the objective, endpoints, trajectory, observers, and comparison baseline are explicit.

success_gates.question: Does the required matter or field source satisfy the declared physical limits?
success_gates.downgrade_condition: Remain not implemented until source reconstruction, conservation, and energy-condition checks exist.

success_gates.question: Is the candidate stable and causally consistent under the declared conditions?
success_gates.downgrade_condition: Remain not implemented until perturbation, horizon, singularity, controllability, and causality checks exist.

success_gates.question: Can a declared traveler remain within survivable local limits?
success_gates.downgrade_condition: Remain not implemented until a traveler model and quantitative tidal, acceleration, field, and radiation bounds exist.

success_gates.question: Can an outside team recover the same scientific result independently?
success_gates.downgrade_condition: Remain not evaluated until a separate contributor and environment publish a reviewed reproduction passport.

success_gates.question: Is there a realizable experiment or engineering path?
success_gates.downgrade_condition: Remain not evaluated until a measurable prediction, uncertainty model, apparatus concept, and material or field requirements exist.

contribution_tasks.title: Ask one precise research question
contribution_tasks.plain_language: Turn one unclear part of the mission into a bounded question with a possible failure condition.

contribution_tasks.title: Draft one candidate
contribution_tasks.plain_language: Write one exact geometry, its assumptions, source expectations, claims, and ways it could fail.

contribution_tasks.title: Challenge one claim
contribution_tasks.plain_language: Identify a hidden assumption, bad equation, missing limit, convention error, or counterexample.

contribution_tasks.title: Repeat one result
contribution_tasks.plain_language: Run a declared result separately and publish the environment, commands, digest, and every difference.

contribution_tasks.title: Build one bounded check
contribution_tasks.plain_language: Add one deterministic validator with tests, limitations, negative cases, and a reproducible command.

contribution_tasks.title: Explain one result
contribution_tasks.plain_language: Make one artifact understandable without changing its status, limitations, or source evidence.

claim_boundaries: The program has not found a spacetime shortcut, transportation geometry, or route to Mars.
The current validator recognizes one exact flat-spacetime benchmark and is not a general relativity solver.
No traveler-preservation, stability, causality, energy, realizability, or experimental gate has passed for a novel candidate.
The separate implementation in this repository is not an outside reproduction.
Agent proposals, votes, popularity, and generated explanations are not scientific evidence or canonical approval.
